args: pcw_root=${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}; case "$pcw_root" in /*) ;; *) printf '%s\n' 'PCW requires an absolute PLUGIN_ROOT or CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT from the plugin host.' >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; if [ ! -r "$pcw_root/scripts/launch.sh" ]; then printf 'PCW bundled launcher is unavailable under: %s\n' "$pcw_root" >&2; exit 2; fi; exec /bin/sh "$pcw_root/scripts/launch.sh" "$@"
